offline.title: Server unreachable
offline.body: BitGauge could not reach the server at {host}. No test can start until it answers.

basePath.title: The base path doesn't match this URL
basePath.body: BitGauge is configured for {basePath} but this page was served at {pagePath}. Its API answers at a different path, so no test can run from here.
basePath.apiBody: This page was served for the base path {basePath}, but the server's API reports {apiBasePath}. The page and the API disagree, so no test can run from here.
basePath.apiBasePath: Base path reported by the API
basePath.hint: Set server.base_path (BITGAUGE_SERVER__BASE_PATH) to the path prefix the reverse proxy forwards, keep the prefix on forwarded requests instead of stripping it, and restart BitGauge.
